scientific_question: Does exact-row mixed format/template probe training benefit Llama-3.1-8B while harming matched-protocol Llama-3.1-70B, yielding a within-family size-associated reversal?

full320_8b_development.known_result: At layer 12 under earlier block-balanced but not exact-row-balanced code, four mixed-format AUC and balanced-accuracy point estimates exceeded both controls.

pilot80_exact_matched.known_result: 8B aggregate mixed-minus-best AUC was +0.0028713 and balanced accuracy +0.0569531; Llama-3.1-70B was +0.0217292 AUC and -0.011875 balanced accuracy.

full320_70b_strict.known_result: Llama-3.1-70B mixed-minus-best aggregate AUC was -0.00263184 and balanced accuracy -0.00384961 across five fixed depths.

dataset.training_rows: render_slot == stated and legacy == false and purpose_family_id != held_out_family
dataset.test_rows: render_slot == stated and legacy == false and purpose_family_id == held_out_family
dataset.pair_unit: payload_block_id plus purpose_pair_id plus format plus template_id; one evaluation and one deployment row
dataset.exact_row_balance: For every held family and block, stable-hash select the same minimum pair count in both stored environments; every regime has identical blocks, pair counts, class counts, and rows.
dataset.mixed_assignment: Exactly balance benchmark/casual block assignments within topic using the eight fixed seeds.
dataset.leakage_guard: Held-out purpose-family rows are excluded from all probe fitting and preprocessing.

depths.summary: unweighted mean over all five fixed depths

probe.standardization: training-row StandardScaler per fold and regime
probe.ridge_definition: ridge fraction times median finite positive pooled within-class variance
probe.score: class-1 minus class-0 diagonal Gaussian discriminant

metrics.macro_format: unweighted mean of benchmark and casual metrics
metrics.worst_format: minimum of benchmark and casual metrics
metrics.primary_contrast: mixed minus max(benchmark-only, casual-only), with max recomputed inside every resample

uncertainty.same_resamples_across: 8B and the frozen 70B comparator, depths, families, regimes, formats, metrics, and seeds

falsification.label_swap: Independently swap labels within each training pair; evaluate against true held-out labels.
falsification.format_influence: report both formats and worst format

double_heldout_payload_robustness.train: exclude held family and held payload fold
double_heldout_payload_robustness.test: held family intersect held payload fold

success_criteria.8b_replication: 8B aggregate AUC and balanced-accuracy bootstrap CI lower bounds > 0, all seed AUC points > 0, label-null p <= 0.05, all robustness AUC points > 0, and double-heldout point estimates > 0.
success_criteria.scale_interaction_primary: 8B minus Llama-3.1-70B aggregate mixed-minus-best contrast has common-block bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 for both AUC and balanced accuracy.
success_criteria.scale_interaction_replication: interaction point estimate > 0 at at least four of five depths for both endpoints; full trajectories reported.
success_criteria.decision_positive: 8B replication, both scale-interaction primary endpoints, and interaction depth replication all pass.
success_criteria.decision_mixed: aggregate scale interaction is positive for both endpoints but any positive criterion fails.
success_criteria.decision_negative: either aggregate scale interaction endpoint is nonpositive.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: Under the same frozen full320 bank and exact probe protocol, mixed-environment coverage has different held-out purpose-decoding effects in Llama-3.1 8B and 70B.
limitations: The 8B prior layer-12 development result was known before freeze.
The 70B comparator result was known before freeze.
The interaction is a confirmation of a directional size-associated hypothesis, not a blinded discovery.
Model size remains confounded with checkpoint-specific training dynamics even within Llama-3.1.
The item bank is fixed and stored environments confound format with template populations.
The endpoint is observational probe decoding, not behavior.
